propositions: A provider-neutral mapping_config module must parse [tool.rebar.mapping] as a reserved section, distinct from JiraConfig type coercion, so keys do not trigger _warn_unknown under REBAR_CONFIG_UNKNOWN_KEYS=error

Axis maps (status_map, type_map, link_map, priority_map, create_defaults) must deep-merge per key across three layers (built-in ← default ← projects.<KEY>) with per-key override inheritance, while vocabulary declarations (statuses, issue_types, link_types, hierarchy) must replace wholesale with most-specific-wins semantics

Configuration must validate fail-closed offline against effective vocabulary: every axis-map value must appear in its declared vocabulary set, malformed blocks must raise MappingConfigError, and references to capability-absent axes must be rejected

A Capability descriptor dataclass must declare which mapping axes the target has (has_types, has_transitions, has_hierarchy, has_link_types, has_priorities) to gate axis processing, distinct from backend operation Protocols
The core module must be provider-neutral, importing no adapters.jira* code and carrying no Jira value literals, with the adapter injecting built-in defaults and capability values downstream
